sql.if: AND prpty.prpty_amd_dt <= to_timestamp(#{prptyAmdEnDt}||' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1 day'
AND (UPPER(prpty.prpty_nm) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{searchName}||'%') OR UPPER(prpty.prpty_logic_nm) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{searchName}||'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: PropertyMapper.selectPropertyCount */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_property prpty INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine prpty_def on prpty_def.prpty_id = prpty.prpty_id AND prpty_def.prpty_def_chg_yn = 'N' WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: PropertyMapper.selectPropertyList */ (ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY prpty.prpty_sort_odrg)) AS rownum ,prpty.prpty_id ,prpty.prpty_nm ,prpty.prpty_logic_nm ,prpty.cnt_prpty_yn ,prpty.cnt_model_id ,prpty.data_array_yn ,prpty.prpty_scrn_indc_yn ,prpty.prpty_desc ,prpty.prpty_data_sttus_mtcd ,code.mtcd_nm as prpty_data_sttus_mtcd_nm ,prpty_def.prpty_def_id ,to_char(prpty.prpty_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS prpty_amd_dt ,prpty_def.domn_model_id ,domnModel.model_nm AS domn_model_nm ,prpty_def.range_model_id ,rangeModel.model_nm AS range_model_nm FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_property prpty INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine prpty_def ON prpty_def.prpty_id = prpty.prpty_id AND prpty_def.prpty_def_chg_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code code ON prpty.prpty_data_sttus_mtcd = code.mtcd AND code.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00002' LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model domnModel ON domnModel.model_id = prpty_def.domn_model_id LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model rangeModel ON rangeModel.model_id = prpty_def.range_model_id WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: PropertyMapper.selectProperty */ prpty.prpty_id ,prpty.up_prpty_id ,upPrpty.prpty_nm AS up_prpty_nm ,prpty.prpty_nm ,prpty.prpty_logic_nm ,prpty.prpty_desc ,prpty.prpty_data_sttus_mtcd ,code.mtcd_nm AS prptyDataSttusMtcdNm ,prpty.prpty_sort_odrg ,prpty.cnt_prpty_yn ,prpty.cnt_model_id ,prpty.data_array_yn ,prpty.prpty_scrn_indc_yn ,prpty.prpty_regr_id ,prpty.prpty_regr_nm ,to_char(prpty.prpty_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS prpty_reg_dt ,prpty.prpty_amdr_id ,prpty.prpty_amdr_nm ,to_char(prpty.prpty_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS prpty_amd_dt ,prpty_def.prpty_def_id ,prpty_def.domn_model_id ,domnModel.model_nm AS domnModelNm ,domnModel.model_logic_nm AS domnModelLogicNm ,prpty_def.range_model_id ,rangeModel.model_nm AS rangeModelNm ,rangeModel.model_logic_nm AS rangeModelLogicNm ,prpty_def.range_mtcd_grp_id ,prpty_def.prpty_def_chg_yn ,prpty_def.prpty_def_chgr_id ,prpty_def.prpty_def_chgr_nm ,to_char(prpty_def.prpty_def_chg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS prpty_def_chg_dt ,prpty_def.prpty_def_chg_why ,prpty_def.prpty_def_regr_id ,prpty_def.prpty_def_regr_nm ,to_char(prpty_def.prpty_def_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS prpty_def_reg_dt ,prpty_def.prpty_def_amdr_id ,prpty_def.prpty_def_amdr_nm ,to_char(prpty_def.prpty_def_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS prpty_def_amd_dt ,prpty_def.ref_prpty_id ,rangeModel.data_type_mtcd AS dataTypeMtcd FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_property prpty INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine prpty_def ON prpty_def.prpty_id = prpty.prpty_id AND prpty_def.prpty_def_chg_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code code ON prpty.prpty_data_sttus_mtcd = code.mtcd and code.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00002' LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model domnModel ON domnModel.model_id = prpty_def.domn_model_id LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model rangeModel ON rangeModel.model_id = prpty_def.range_model_id LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property upPrpty ON prpty.up_prpty_id = upPrpty.prpty_id WHERE 1=1 AND prpty.prpty_id = #{prptyId}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: PropertyMapper.selectPropertyNameCheck */ SUM(cnt) as cnt FROM ( SELECT COUNT(prpty.prpty_nm) AS cnt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_property prpty WHERE prpty_nm = #{prptyNm} UNION ALL /* 키워드 프라퍼티 */ SELECT COUNT(code.mtcd) AS cnt FROM dtmeta.tb_portal_code code WHERE code.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00011' AND code.mtcd_use_yn = 'Y' AND code.mtcd = #{prptyNm} ) a
SELECT /* SQL_ID: PropertyMapper.selectPropertyIdCheck */ COUNT(prpty.prpty_Id) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_property prpty WHERE prpty_Id = #{prptyId}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: PropertyMapper.selectPropertyDefine */ prpty_def_id , prpty_id , domn_model_id , range_model_id , range_mtcd_grp_id , ref_prpty_id , prpty_def_chg_yn , prpty_def_chgr_id , prpty_def_chgr_nm , to_char(prpty_def_chg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS prpty_def_chg_dt , prpty_def_chg_why , prpty_def_amdr_id , prpty_def_amdr_nm , to_char(prpty_def_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS prpty_def_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine WHERE prpty_id = #{prptyId} AND prpty_def_chg_yn = 'N'

SELECT /* SQL_ID: PropertyMapper.selectPropertyDefineChgList */ (ROW_NUMBER() OVER(order by prpty_def.prpty_def_chg_dt)) AS rownum , prpty_def.domn_model_id , prpty_def.range_model_id , to_char(prpty_def.prpty_def_chg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as prptyDefChgDt , prpty_def.prpty_def_chg_why , prpty_def.prpty_def_chg_yn , domnModel.model_nm as domnModelNm , rangeModel.model_nm as rangeModelNm FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine prpty_def LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model domnModel on domnModel.model_id = prpty_def.domn_model_id LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model rangeModel on rangeModel.model_id = prpty_def.range_model_id WHERE prpty_def.prpty_id =#{prptyId} AND prpty_def.prpty_def_chg_yn = 'Y'

SELECT /* SQL_ID: PropertyMapper.selectPropertyDataTypeList */ t1.prpty_nm , COALESCE(t3.data_type_mtcd, 'string') AS range_data_type_mtcd , t2.range_model_id AS range_model_id , t3.model_type_mtcd AS range_model_type_mtcd FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_property t1 INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine t2 ON t1.prpty_id = t2.prpty_id AND t2.prpty_def_chg_yn = 'N' INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t3 ON t2.range_model_id = t3.model_id AND t3.model_data_sttus_mtcd = 'use' WHERE t1.prpty_data_sttus_mtcd = 'use' ORDER BY t1.prpty_nm
